title: OL-TRIGGERS-INSTALL: register the signed GitHub webhook on the live worker
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** the worker URL is known (deploy of ultrastable-tick) and gh and wrangler are authenticated; checked every heartbeat
**Done check:** file:ops/loop-evidence/webhook-installed.json
**Status:** closed

Run `python3 -m foundation triggers --install ultrastable/ultrastable <worker-url> --apply`: mints the webhook secret in memory, registers the GitHub webhook and stores GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET on the worker. Writes the marker file on success. Until then events fall back to the cron heartbeat.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 221.2 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
